headline: Anthropic Adds Security to Prevent AI Model Misuse
summary: Anthropic added safeguards to its AI model to prevent misuse, lifting US export controls.
details: Anthropic added a new security measure to its Claude Fable 5 AI model to prevent users from accessing restricted capabilities. The safeguard will notify users that their request is blocked and process their query with the less-advanced Opus 4.8 AI model.

The Trump administration had imposed export controls on Anthropic's AI model due to concerns over its potential misuse. The company agreed to extend an existing guardrail to prevent users from trying to access certain restricted capabilities.

The Commerce Department cleared Fable 5 for release after researchers decided the safeguards on the model were sufficiently robust. However, defense secretary Pete Hegseth still designates Anthropic a supply chain risk.
caption:
Can AI models be made safe from misuse? Anthropic adds new safeguards.

Anthropic added a new security measure to its Claude Fable 5 AI model to prevent users from accessing restricted capabilities. The safeguard will notify users that their request is blocked and process their query with the less-advanced Opus 4.8 AI model.

The Trump administration had imposed export controls on Anthropic's AI model due to concerns over its potential misuse. The company agreed to extend an existing guardrail to prevent users from trying to access certain restricted capabilities.

The Commerce Department cleared Fable 5 for release after researchers decided the safeguards on the model were sufficiently robust. However, defense secretary Pete Hegseth still designates Anthropic a supply chain risk.
